verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://neon.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key. The Management API's LLM-addressed index (docs/reference/api/llms.txt, also probed live) links the machine-readable OpenAPI spec at neon.com/api_spec/release/v2.json "for request/response validation and codegen". Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of using the spec (e.g., codegen hands-on), and no evidence of specs for the Data API or other interfaces beyond the Management API.
